name: application-podcast-episode-row
title: Podcast Episode Row
description: Podcast episode list rows with cover art, title/publish date, formatted duration, a play button, and a download action — distinct from track-list-row, which is a music-playback list with playing-state highlighting rather than podcast episode metadata and a download action.
useWhen: Listing podcast episodes with publish date and duration.
Listeners need both a play and a separate offline-download action per episode.
Duration should be formatted from real seconds rather than a hand-typed string.
avoidWhen: You're showing a music playback queue with a currently-playing highlight — use track-list-row instead.
Episodes don't support offline download — omit the download button rather than disabling it.
You need full transport controls for active playback — use now-playing-bar instead.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are full-width within their container; the episode title truncates first to preserve the art, play button, and download button.
accessibility: Play and download buttons both have episode-specific aria-labels rather than generic 'Play'/'Download' text.
Duration is formatted from a real durationSeconds value via a shared helper, not hand-typed per episode.
Cover art is aria-hidden since the title text already identifies the episode.

variants.title: Podcast episode row
variants.description: Two episodes with real formatted durations (42:15 and 38:47) and publish dates, each with play and download actions, on a light surface.
accessibility: Duration text matches durationSeconds exactly via the shared formatDuration function.

variants.title: Podcast episode row (Dark)
variants.description: The same two episodes, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Button icon colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
